content:
FINAL PRODUCTION ACCEPTANCE — EXECUTE, DO NOT RE-AUDIT GIT

The Git repository audit is complete.

Do not perform another Git history audit, commit audit, SHA audit, or secret scan.

Treat the repository integrity as VERIFIED and move to final production acceptance.

Complete and provide evidence for these items only:

1. MEMBER REGISTRATION
- Register a new production test member.
- Verify email/OTP flow.
- Confirm one Auth user and one Member record are created.
- Verify the member appears in the Members module.
- Sign in successfully.
- Log out and sign in again.

2. OWNER AUTHENTICATION
- Owner login succeeds.
- Owner Dashboard opens.
- Admin Hub opens.
- Variables remain owner-only.
- Session persists after app restart.
- Invalid credentials are rejected.

3. PRODUCTION DATA
Verify read/write operations for:
- Members
- Investors
- Buyers
- Properties
- Deals
- Reels
- Messages
- Documents

4. PRIMARY AI
- Verify the primary AI provider is active.
- Confirm fallback is used only during provider failure.
- Verify chat history persists correctly.

5. MOBILE QA
Android:
- Build installs.
- Login works.
- Registration works.
- Reels work.
- Chat works.
- No crashes.

iOS:
- Verify approved test flow or build status.

6. WEB QA
Verify:
- Landing
- Registration
- Login
- Owner access
- Chat
- Health endpoint
- Version endpoint

7. FINAL DEPLOYMENT
Provide:
- GitHub HEAD SHA
- Final merged SHA
- Render deployment ID
- Live /version SHA
- SHA parity confirmation

8. FINAL CERTIFICATION

Return only:

PASS or FAIL for:
- Member Registration
- Member Sign-in
- Owner Sign-in
- Owner Dashboard
- Production Data
- Primary AI
- Android
- iOS
- Web
- Deployment
- SHA Parity

If any item fails, stop and report:
- exact file
- exact endpoint
- exact error
- exact root cause
- exact fix required

Do not repeat repository audits. Complete the production acceptance and certify IVX only after all production tests pass.
